_comment: X fetcher config (brand/pipeline/fetch-x.mjs). Keyword queries run with since:<now - windowDays>; authors are grouped into tiers (S/A/B) and batched into (from:a OR from:b …) searches with per-tier min_faves. S tier = top prompt authorities, no fave gate; A tier = active prompt sharers/educators; B tier = Chinese image/video prompt creators. Handles are case-insensitive, no @. Authors not on X (e.g. 李继刚 on 即刻, Bilibili UP主) are tracked in the multi-platform watchlist (phase 2).

queries.query: prompt ("gpt image" OR "gpt-image" OR "gpt-image-2" OR "chatgpt image") min_faves:150 -filter:replies
prompt ("nano banana" OR nanobanana OR gemini) (image OR photo OR 🍌) min_faves:150 -filter:replies
(prompt OR 提示词) (seedream OR 即梦 OR dreamina) min_faves:40 -filter:replies
prompt (seedance OR kling OR 可灵 OR veo OR hailuo OR sora) min_faves:120 -filter:replies
prompt ("flux 2" OR "flux.2" OR "flux kontext" OR bfl_ai) min_faves:30 -filter:replies
提示词 (即梦 OR seedream OR "nano banana" OR gemini OR 生图 OR AI绘画) min_faves:40 -filter:replies
